Community Guidelines

SupportPrivacyTermsSafety

Effective: October 1, 2026

Write honestly. Reply kindly. Protect everyone’s privacy.

Be supportive

Respond to the person, not just the situation. You may disagree, but do not shame, insult, intimidate, or pile on.

Protect privacy

Do not post names, addresses, phone numbers, usernames, workplaces, schools, photos, or other details that could identify you or someone else. Do not expose private conversations without permission.

Do not post

  • Threats, harassment, bullying, stalking, or encouragement of violence.
  • Hateful or dehumanizing content aimed at protected groups.
  • Sexual exploitation or any sexual content involving minors.
  • Instructions, encouragement, or graphic depictions of suicide, self-harm, eating disorders, or dangerous acts.
  • Illegal content, scams, impersonation, malware, or instructions for wrongdoing.
  • Copyrighted or private material you do not have permission to share.
  • Spam, advertising, fundraising, solicitation, or repeated posts.

Distress and crisis content

You may express difficult feelings and ask for support. Do not encourage harm or provide instructions for self-harm. Unsend is not monitored as a crisis service. If someone may be in immediate danger, contact local emergency services. In the United States and its territories, call or text 988.

Reporting and enforcement

Use Report on a post or reply that breaks these rules. We may hide or remove content and take other reasonable action. For urgent concerns, email typhoon.lab.app@gmail.com. Do not make false or retaliatory reports.

Appeals

If your content was removed and you believe that was a mistake, email typhoon.lab.app@gmail.com with the content, approximate posting time, and reason for your appeal.
